summary: Mint Incorporation Limited (Nasdaq: MIMI), a Hong Kong AI/robotics and interior fit-out company, filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 9, 2026 press release announcing a non-binding MOU between its majority-owned JV Rice Robotics AGI Holding Limited and Edvance Innovation Limited. Edvance becomes exclusive MENA distributor for Morocco, non-exclusive elsewhere, targeting 3,000 education robotics units over 36 months with a first 50-unit order by November 30, 2026, subject to specification and pricing. No price, stake, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed; the MOU is commercial, not a special situation.
